s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of palpitations with sinus tachycardia and arrhythmia in the context of chemotherapy treatment
salient_findings: Sinus tachycardia and marked sinus arrhythmia on ECG
Frequent atrial premature beats and short-array chamber tachycardia on dynamic ECG
Heart valve degeneration and impaired left ventricular diastolic function on UCG
key_facts: 44-year-old female patient
Experienced palpitations on the day of chemotherapy treatment
No history of diabetes, hypertension, mental illness, or cardiovascular/cerebrovascular disease
Underweight with a BMI of 18.96 kg/m2
Initial heart rate of 121 bpm
Normal complete blood count
Normal electrolyte levels
Normal serum TroponinT, BNP, CKMB, and Myoglobin levels
ECG showed sinus tachycardia and marked sinus arrhythmia
Dynamic ECG showed frequent atrial premature beats and short-array chamber tachycardia
UCG showed heart valve degeneration, aortic regurgitation, mitral regurgitation, tricuspid regurgitation, and impaired left ventricular diastolic function
